title: Your AI Agent Isn't an Engineer: The Art of Thoughtful Anthropomorphism
talk_summary: A DevRel talk arguing AI tools should avoid anthropomorphic 'AI engineer' marketing and instead use clear naming, transparency, developer control, demos, docs, and community prompt sharing. It is mostly marketing guidance, with little direct engineering evidence for agent efficiency.

takeaways.what_they_do: Publish reusable prompt playbooks and community prompt collections so users can copy proven prompts and rules.
takeaways.evidence_quote: you want to have prompt playbooks

takeaways.what_they_do: Use clear non-human role names like agent, assistant, or reviewer instead of 'AI engineer' to set expectations.
Give users control over LLM choice, verbosity, and debugging logs so they can adapt behavior to their workflow.
takeaways.evidence_quote: give them the ability to customize the choice of their llm customize the behavior

takeaways.what_they_do: Learn and document the agentic loop: request, LLM plan, tool calls, revision, delivery, plus token/context/tool-calling limits.
